newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 4 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 4 PM.

text.p: * Members of parliament's 143-strong upper house voted by 87 to 52 to elect former Prime Minister Petre Roman, of the Social Democratic Union (USD), as Senate speaker.
Roman, 50, told senators that the score of Wednesday's vote showed that the political accord signed by the USD and the Democratic Convention (CDR) was working well.

* National Peasant Party leader Ion Diaconescu was elected speaker of parliament's lower Chamber of Deputies. Diaconescu, 78, said he had accepted that appointment only upon the insistence of fellow party members.
* Both parliament houses worked in session through the afternoon to elect leading boards.

* The National Unity Party (PUNR) slammed the CDR for taking the Hungarian Democratic Party (UDMR) into the new government, PUNR vice-president Gheorghe Secara told a news conference. He said that would encourage ethnic Hungarians to campaign for ethnic autonomy.
Secara also said his party would not enter any coalition in parliament. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
